prompt:
Create a vertical tarot card illustration of a joyful chibi girl as “The Sun” card. The central scene shows one cute 3D anime-style toddler-like girl with oversized head, rosy cheeks, closed happy crescent eyes, open laughing mouth, and messy warm brown hair tied into a loose bun with stray curls. She is skipping forward on a stone path with arms spread wide, wearing a dark charcoal oversized hoodie with a small white cat face emblem on the chest, tan shorts, cream socks, brown lace-up ankle boots, a small brown leather crossbody satchel with buckles, and a tiny round cat charm. Beside her is exactly one small fluffy white-and-gray tabby cat, also smiling with closed eyes and an open happy mouth, walking through the flowers. The setting is a glowing fairytale sunflower meadow at golden hour, with many tall yellow sunflowers on both sides, scattered golden leaves, soft clouds, blue sky, distant lake, rolling hills, cypress-like trees, and a small castle village in the background. A large cute smiling sun with blush cheeks and radiating beams fills the upper-right sky.

Design the whole image as an ornate vintage tarot card on aged parchment. Use a dark navy and antique gold Art Nouveau border with rounded corners, fine filigree vines, stars, moons, and celestial symbols. Include exactly four large corner medallions: top-left star compass, top-right star compass, bottom-left crescent moon and star, bottom-right crescent moon and star. Include a top center circular medallion containing a stylized sun, with moon phase symbols spread along the top border. Add decorative cloud motifs and small mountain silhouettes near the lower border. At the bottom, place a cream title plaque with the exact text THE SUN in large dark serif capitals. Use warm cinematic lighting, highly detailed storybook textures, whimsical fantasy atmosphere, soft depth of field, painterly 3D rendering, cozy kawaii expression, crisp composition, and no extra text or watermark.
